newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar touch firmer, trade light.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar touch firmer, trade light.

text.p: Volume picked up slightly on London's white sugar futures market on Friday but traders said they were reluctant to embark on much new activity before the evening's sugar dinner.
Nearby positions were marginally firmer in afternoon trade and clawed their way back towards opening levels after the earlier weakness seen from routine business.
Traders said the March/May spread had attracted some interest but otherwise activity was dull.
At 1526 GMT December was up 70 cents at $317.40 and March up 20 cents at $314.00. Volume amounted to a light 407 lots.
Technically, both the December and March contracts are following a downtrend channel starting from the reaction low on September 17.
The March channel is pointing much more sharply downwards, with all of the week's highs below the 10-day moving average.
Both contracts' 14-day relative strength indices (RSIs) are hovering in oversold territory, as are the slow stochastic indicators.
Technical analysts said the whites market could be due for a bounce as the RSI was likely to correct upwards. Nearby support for December was pegged at $315.00 and resistance at $318.50.
Trading was minimal on the Paris market where volume totalled just 83 lots. December was down 10 cents at $316.50 and March up 30 cents at $314.50.
